New home with separate garage and porch

Build a new one-story home in Boise, Idaho. Conditioned living area is 50 by 40 feet, exactly 2000 SF. Attached unconditioned garage is 20 by 22 feet, exactly 440 SF, in addition to living area. Covered porch is 8 by 10 feet, exactly 80 SF, also additional. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms, 9-foot ceilings, standard wood framing, slab-on-grade, asphalt shingle roof, mid-range finishes. Include complete house construction and normal MEP, kitchen, bathrooms, garage and porch. Kitchen has 18 LF base and 12 LF wall cabinets, 45 SF quartz. Bathrooms each have one toilet and one vanity; one has a tub/shower and one a shower. Level cleared lot, normal access and working hours, utilities stubbed at building perimeter. Exclude land, design, engineering, permit fees, utility extensions beyond building perimeter, landscaping and appliances. Do not add kitchen or bathroom components again if included in a complete house assembly.
